_about: Photos with Marsh's own reading of them, to check photo interpretation (CP-05) against. A case's source is a page of a sample report (the largest image on it) or an image file, relative to the repo root. The redacted sample reports keep only these two OFI photos; add cases from unredacted reports or your own site photos, with what Marsh would write, as they become available.
